module: HID Global ActivID Applet Suite v2.6.2B on Oberthur Technologies ID-One Cosmo V7
caveat: When operated with module Oberthur ID-One Cosmo V7-n validated to FIPS 140-2 under Cert. #1236 operating in FIPS mode
description: This product combines the Oberthur Technologies ID-One Cosmo V7 card loaded with the HID Global ActivID Applet Suite v2.6.2B. The smart card is a JC2.2.2 & GP2.1.1 compliant dual-interface module. HID ActivID Applet framework works over dual-interface and supports GSC-IS v2.1 specifications. The product supports secure issuance and post-issuance along with SMA protocol (secure messaging) for FIPS 140-2 L3 and One Time Password generation. The combined product is suitable for government and corporate deployments.
hardware_versions: P/Ns B0, BA, C4 and C7
firmware_versions: FC10 / 069778 with HID Global ActivID Applet Suite Version 2.6.2B.7

other_fields.Other Algorithms: Triple-DES (Triple-DES Cert. #698, key wrapping; key establishment methodology provides 112 bits of encryption strength); RSA (key wrapping; key establishment methodology provides 112 bits of encryption strength); NDRNG
